house.description: Dakota County mental health crisis services funding provided, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Human Services Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money to fund mental health crisis services in Dakota County.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; DAKOTA COUNTY MENTAL HEALTH CRISIS SERVICES. +]

[+$3,400,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Dakota County for mental health crisis services, including mobile crisis response, crisis follow-up and stabilization services, and embedded social workers with local public safety agencies. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money to fund mental health crisis services in Dakota County.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; DAKOTA COUNTY MENTAL HEALTH CRISIS SERVICES.

$3,400,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Dakota County for mental health crisis services, including mobile crisis response, crisis follow-up and stabilization services, and embedded social workers with local public safety agencies. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: APPROPRIATION; DAKOTA COUNTY MENTAL HEALTH CRISIS SERVICES.

This is a onetime appropriation.
